```yaml
name: Release Scrapers

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths:
      - 'scraper/**'
      - 'dune-project'
      - 'dune'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-and-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install OCaml
        uses: ocaml/setup-ocaml@v3
        with:
          ocaml-version: "5.1"
          dune-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: opam install . --deps-only --with-test

      - name: Build scraper
        run: dune build src/scraper/scrape.exe

      - name: Get current date
        id: date
        run: echo "date=$(date +'%Y-%m-%d')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: scraper-latest
          name: Scraper Latest
          body: "Automated release of the scraper binary built on ${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}"
          files: _build/default/src/scraper/scrape.exe
          make_latest: true
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
